No, not really. Initially I wanted to do some magic code trickery and potentially make it a collaborative page in which the 40 lines omitted would just be a collapsible to which you could add stuff by typing it in the terminal, but 1. I just didn’t have the skills to do so1 2. I thought it would be ultimately pointless and would just detract from the main joke 3. I feel like creating new Object Classes for a table rather than for articles would be ultimately utterly meaningless. Thanks for the question though!

Footnotes
1. And yes, I know I could’ve just made it so people can edit the potentially collapsed cells of the table to add stuff, but my second and third points still stand.

item.content:encoded:
I guess the joke here is trying to explain the proliferation of astandard object classes in a fun and cutesy way. Unfortunately, this ends up getting conflated with a weird ligma joke, and mostly just seems to be relying on the observation that "whoa, object classes, aren't they just silly", rather than craft a setup and punchline. It's too silly to have any payoff, but it's not silly enough to work for me.

I think there's something to be said that a joke article about esoteric object classes unironically uses ACS. That just seems like a missed opportunity.

item.title: how the hell did this survive
item.content:encoded:
I am not sorry. The existence of this article is solely SCPD’s fault. All of the needed citation is provided in the Ayers Infomodule.

Edit: Alright, so I suppose this gets comments gets a bunch of new words now that I woke up. I think I should explain what the hell this is - two months ago, I said on SCPD that if SCP-5464 somehow reaches +100, I will write something whilst drunk, similarly to what PeppersGhost did with SCP-3943 after winning the SCP-4000 Contest. People only encouraged me of course. However, since I had no such beverages at my disposal, I thought that sleep deprivation is a good substitute. This is the product of that challenge.

Edit 2: One more thing - I don’t actually hate Esoteric Object Classes. Whilst I don’t personally use them, I don’t mind them. It’s just a joke.
